# THOUGHT Glyph Library — Second Set — review status

## Outcome

Set 2 contains the requested **36 complete fonts: 12 per construction type**. Its frozen qualification label is `exploratory-complete`.

The set is a broad design field, not a claim that every member has passed the final gallery or deployment gates.

| Gate | Pass | Hold |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Legibility critic | 21 | 15 |
| Identity/distinctness critic | 20 | 16 |
| Both visual critics | 9 | 27 |
| Expanded native-SVG protocol | 36 | 0 |
| Compact/on-chain storage | 0 | 36 |

## Nine dual-pass candidates

These passed both current visual critics. They remain candidates because the original study protocol calls for further independent blind review and cross-renderer evidence.

- **02 · Segment masks:** `row-ledger`, `column-relay`, `perimeter-tape`, `port-gap-code`, `bias-weave`
- **03 · Stroke graph:** `orthogonal-truss`, `octilinear-knot`
- **04 · Routed path:** `depth-trace`, `perimeter-relay`

## Qualification boundary

- All 36 are complete 76-character, deterministic, monospaced native-SVG path systems.
- All 36 pass the current expanded-path syntax, bounds, hash, fixture, and loader checks.
- The expanded path format measures 29,047–304,709 path bytes per font and is not deployable as one Ethereum runtime.
- The 365/411-byte compact figures are data floors only; no shared decoder/runtime has been measured.
- Do not rename the bundle `study-qualified` until the holds are revised or removed and the required visual and renderer reviews pass.
